buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 3. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Dy.CE/Bridge/Line/Agra DRM Campus Agra Cantt Agra, Uttar Pradesh Pin 282001 North Central Railway, Agra Email: dycebrlagra@gmail.com . 4. Service & Support In the event where the distance travelled exceeds the monthly usage variant, amount will be paid for additional Kms as per schedule. Similarly, the unused Kms in a particular month as against the minimum guaranteed usage variant will be carried forward to the next month and additional Km if any in the next month shall be adjusted against this. However, the payment for the selected usage variant in a month will be paid every month.” Further, the unused Kms in a particular month shall not be carried forward or adjusted beyond 6 months 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Sr.DFM/AGRA/NCR payable at Agra

. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Sr.DFM/AGRA/NCR payable at Agra . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Sr.DFM/AGRA/NCR A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT 1. The vehicle has to be provided on the date of start of the contract. 2. Railway administration will have right to terminate the contract by giving 03 days notice to the owner of the vehicle, if in view or the Railway's vehicle is not required for further use on Railway account. 3. The vehicle shall move according to instructions of Dy.CE/Bridge/Line/Agra or his authorized representati ve. Log book shall be maintained by the driver which will be signed by the official using the vehicle or othe r person authorized by him. 4. Rly. Administration shall not be responsible for any accident, damage etc. to the vehicle/driver during th e period of hire. 5. The vehicle should be registered as a commercial vehicle with road transport office failing which penalty levied by Road Transport Authority will be paid by the contractor, and contractor should submit relevant p apers of registration or vehicle before starting the work. Comprehensive insurance of the vehicles should b e valid and complete in all respect. Driving licence of the driver must also be valid. All the papers should b e submitted by the contractor. 6. In case vehicle goes out of order, an alternative vehicle must be arranged by the owner within reasonabl e time. If the vehicle is not provided on requirement of officer in charge, the vehicle will be hired from the l ocal market by the administration & hire charges will be recovered from the bill of the contractor along wit h a penalty of Rs. 50/- per hour of delay. 7. If the vehicle does not turn up any day, three times to normal rate per day on pro-rata basis will be dedu cted from the bill.

8. Toll tax, barrier tax, parwana etc., if any, shall be borne by the contractor. 9. The vehicle provided by the contractor should have proper seat cover etc. and seat cover to be cleaned r egularly. On non availability of cleaned seat cover, Rs. 50/- per day will be deducted from the bill of the con tractor. 10. The cost of hiring quoted by the tenderer should include salary of driver, cost of Diesel & other consumabl es, all repairs, maintenance, all taxes applicable on hired vehicles by road transport authorities (like regist ration charges, insurance charges etc.) for which nothing extra will be payable. 11. No accommodation will be provided to the driver of the vehicle by the Railways. 12. Rates quoted shall be valid throughout the period of contract. 13. The vehicle should be in good running condition & model should be not earlier than 2024. 14. The working hours will be 24 hours a day including Sunday & holiday. 15. Contractor shall provide suitable driver for the vehicle for specified period as mentioned in schedule. On no n availability of driver, penalty of Rs. 1000/- per day or part thereof will be imposed in the contractor. 16. The vehicle provided by the contractor will be required at Agra under DyCE/Bridge/Line/Agra Jurisdiction to ply on all kind of roads for inspection in section & if required the vehicle along with driver may have to sta y out station sometimes. 17. Nothing extra will be paid to the contractor due to fluctuation in the cost of diesel or any other Consumabl e items, registration charges, taxes etc. 18. Driver of vehicle should be experienced and having proper valid driving license. 19. Vehicles are to be supplied and work has to be executed strictly as per tender schedule and specification g iven by the Railway. 20. Contractor has to submit power of attorney in favour of one who is authorized to sign various documents, bills, M.B. Contract Agreement etc, to enter into contract agreement and submit partnership deal if any. 21. Contractor will provide Mahindra Marazzo, Maruti Suzuki Ertiga or similar type vehicle only. 22. All the Taxes and duties what so ever livable by the government (State /central) or anybody shall be borne by the contractor. 23. The vehicles of contractors can be drafted by the Railway Administrations in case of accidents/ natural cala mities involving human lives. 24. Payment to the contractor/vender would be made through EFT/ECS. 25. Payment of vehicle shall be made after 3 month of service provider by the buyer. 26. Vehicle can run in jurisdiction of NCR whenever required so have permit to MP, UP, Haryana and Rajasthan. 27. Vehicle will be available 24 Hrs and whenever driver will go on leave/rest than alternate driver will be avail able. 28. Service provider/driver will available on 24 Hrs on phone. 29. Driver should be well mannered and well behaved.

30. The driver will not use intoxicants during the duty at vehicle. 31. Toll charges, parking charges will be paid by the service provider. 32. Non-working days vehicle should be stay at SSE/Bridge/IDH Office. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA File Attachment Click here to view the file.
